reasons.label: Match result
reasons.text: RB Leipzig are favoured at 70%, against 14% for Racing Club de Lens and 16% for the draw. RB Leipzig carry 200 more Elo points into the match. Over the last five: RB Leipzig 1.8 points per game, Racing Club de Lens 1.2. They average 3.0 points per game at home this season.

reasons.label: Goals
reasons.text: The model expects 4.21 goals, which puts it over 2.5 at 79%. Across their last five, RB Leipzig and Racing Club de Lens have scored 1.4 and conceded 2.4 a game between them. RB Leipzig are the sharper of the two in front of goal right now, not Racing Club de Lens.

reasons.label: Self-correction
reasons.text: Adjusted from this competition's own record: goals were predicted 3.11 against 3.63 actual across 182 settled forecasts, so the rate is nudged up 16.9% to stop the model leaning under.

limitations: Only 3 league matches of this season behind the weaker-evidenced side, so form leans on last season.
